effects.instruction: Narrator only: end this turn with one short line of its own giving the weekday, date and clock time, with a.m. or p.m. (a clock time, not a part of the day), that the scene has reached by the end of the turn, e.g. Saturday, April 6 — 2:10 p.m. Start from the Current time; move the clock only as far as the scene really goes (a talk or a meal takes minutes, a trip home and dinner takes hours), and past midnight give the new date.
